name: Atmospheric Filtration Membrane
description: A nanoporous membrane that selectively passes oxygen and nitrogen while blocking particulates, toxins, and pathogens. AFMs are installed in building ventilation systems, personal respirators, and the dome-like enclosures that protect Tier 4-5 neighborhoods from polluted outside air. The membrane self-cleans by shedding accumulated particles.
